card.name: The word of after relief or treatment
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after nouns like relief, management, treatment or signs and symptoms in indication statements for pain and arthritis drugs. Also fires on words like "the", "acute" or "severe" in the same phrases.

modes.label: of after indication noun
modes.description: "of" following relief, treatment, management or symptoms, before the named condition.
modes.example: For the relief<< of>> the signs and symptoms of osteoar

modes.label: Adjectives before pain
modes.description: Severity words inside an indication phrase, just before the word pain.
modes.example: management of moderately severe<< acute>> pain that requires analgesia at
